Lyrics.note: Estimated probability that an e2 box is lyric text on a vocal page.

acceptChoice.reason: Lower instrumental-page false positives at the same calibrated precision; chosen after seeing held-out results, not before.

caveats: Detector training membership was reconstructed (fusion-v1-training-membership-audit.json): about 80% of the Lieder scores here sat in the OCR-first training pool. On the 29 verifiably clean scores the matched share is 57.8% against 51.3% on possibly-trained scores, and the judged lyric rate at raw 0.7+ is 18/19 against 63/70, so there is no sign of inflation; the clean judged sample is only 19 boxes.
Matched boxes are true by OCR/score agreement; unmatched boxes use a sampled human rate.
Boxes below raw 0.5 were not sampled; the bins carry no information about them.
fit.definition: Precision is P(box contains lyric text) on a vocal page. A box that spans several words or stacked lyric lines still counts as lyric text; the judging could not separate them.

note: Lyrics (e2) are calibrated against OCR-confirmed positives and a sampled human judgement of unmatched boxes; directions and dynamics (e4) are pinned but uncalibrated, so they always stay in review.
